dishes.name: Black Forest cake
dishes.desc: Chocolate sponge, whipped cream and sour cherries soaked in kirsch. Born in the Black Forest, where it is still made with local cherries.

dishes.name: Black Forest ham
dishes.desc: Dry-cured, smoked ham with a dark crust, made in the Black Forest with a protected origin. Eaten thinly sliced on bread or as Speck.

dishes.name: Lange Rote
dishes.desc: Freiburg's long grilled sausage in a roll, sold from stalls on the Münsterplatz. A market-day lunch for locals.

dishes.name: Bibbeleskäs
dishes.desc: Fresh quark with herbs, onions and cream, eaten with boiled potatoes or bread. A simple Baden dish from the Upper Rhine.

dishes.name: Breisgau Flammkuchen
dishes.desc: Thin crisp dough with crème fraîche, onions and bacon, baked in a hot oven. Imported from Alsace and a local favorite in Freiburg.
